scope: Discord 2v2 integration regression; no new card admission or certification.
behaviors: A set Giant Trunade is activated through handleTagComponent and the persisted tagStore action path.
Five cards in the two shared team backrows return to the four physical owners, including the source itself.
The inactive teammate cannot submit the team's action.
All four hands may reach seven during Main Phase; no discard occurs before End Phase.
At End Phase each physical seat discards once, in A1/B1/A2/B2 order, returning every hand to six.
Public/private Discord payloads validate; private hand contents remain per-seat.
All 120 Main Deck UIDs and identities, Extra Deck UIDs, player rows, and player_cards remain unchanged.
limitations: Discord was exercised offline through the production component handler and payload builders; no live guild/token was used.
The repository could not be cloned in the local container because network access was unavailable; GitHub Actions is the executable validation environment.
